result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.union()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Compute the union of this graph with another graph. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L12416-L12499){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.union(other) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Returns a new graph containing all nodes and edges from both graphs. Nodes with the same ID are merged (this graph's attributes take precedence). Duplicate edges are not added. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [other]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The graph to union with. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A new graph containing all nodes and edges from both graphs. ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ValueError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If the graphs have different directedness (one directed, one undirected). ::: ## Technical Notes {.doc-technical-notes} - Both graphs must have the same directedness - Node IDs are preserved; overlapping IDs are merged - This graph's node labels/attributes take precedence - Weighted if either graph is weighted ## Examples {.doc-examples} Merge two graphs: ::: {#fa38118e .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec # Create two graphs g1 = ec.Graph(directed=False) g1.add_node(label="A") g1.add_node(label="B") g1.add_edge("A", "B") g2 = ec.Graph(directed=False) g2.add_node(label="B") g2.add_node(label="C") g2.add_edge("B", "C") # Union combines both result = g1.union(g2) # Returns 3 (A, B, C) result.count_nodes() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 2 ``` ::: ::: ::: {#357bf76f .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Returns 2 (A-B, B-C) result.count_edges() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` 1 ``` ::: ::: Combine network snapshots: ::: {#11c08059 .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Network at time t1 t1 = ec.Graph(directed=False) t1.add_path_graph(3) # 1-2-3 # Network at time t2 (new connection) t2 = ec.Graph(directed=False) for i in range(1, 4): t2.add_node() t2.add_edge(1, 3) # Direct connection # Combined network combined = t1.union(t2) # Returns 3 combined.count_edges() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` 3 ``` ::: :::
